answer: Sybil resistance binds identities to attributable bonded escrow: if k coordinated identities equivocate on one consensus event, correlated evidence triggers a penalty proportional to k², rather than k separate linear fines. Detection further applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier (e^{αk}) to the swarm’s stake; asymmetric depreciation prevents seized value from being restored. Splitting a validator into mirror identities offers no discount: the trellis of signed messages links conduct, making concealment costly until dawn.
